title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization and Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Providing Judicial Services and Safeguards for Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization and Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization

Fa Fa [2021] No. 23

In order to thoroughly implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches at the Central Conference on Rural Work and at the celebration of the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China, fully implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, Fourth, and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, comprehensively implement the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization and Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization" and the "Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Achieving the Effective Connection between Consolidating and Expanding the Achievements of Poverty Alleviation and Rural Revitalization," and give full play to the adjudication functions of the people's courts to provide strong judicial services and safeguards for comprehensively promoting rural revitalization and accelerating agricultural and rural modernization, the following opinions are hereby put forward.

I. Unify Ideological Understanding, Accurately Grasp the Overall Requirements for Providing Judicial Services for Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization and Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization

1. Correctly Grasp the Guiding Ideology for Providing Judicial Services for Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization and Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization. Comprehensively promoting rural revitalization and accelerating agricultural and rural modernization are major strategic deployments made by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core. People's courts at all levels must adhere to the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the Central Conference on Rural Work, fully implement the guiding principles of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, Fourth, and Fifth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, implement the spirit of the Central Conference on Rural Work, enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," and achieve the "Two Upholds." Based on the new development stage, they must fully, accurately, and comprehensively implement the new development concept, construct a new development pattern, promote high-quality development, adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, adhere to the Party's comprehensive leadership over work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, adhere to the priority development of agriculture and rural areas, and provide strong judicial services and safeguards for a good start and solid steps in comprehensively building a modern socialist country.

2. Deeply Understand the Great Significance of Providing Judicial Services for Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization and Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization. Since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has consistently regarded solving the "three rural issues" (agriculture, rural areas, and farmers) as the top priority of the Party's work. At a historical juncture of marching towards the second centenary goal of building a great modern socialist country in all respects, consolidating and expanding the achievements of poverty alleviation, comprehensively promoting rural revitalization, and accelerating agricultural and rural modernization are major issues related to the overall situation. People's courts at all levels must fully understand the importance and urgency of doing a good job in work related to agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the new development stage, insist on placing judicial services and safeguards for the "three rural issues" at the top of their work, adopt practical and effective measures to promote rural revitalization, and promote high-quality and efficient agriculture, livable and business-friendly rural areas, and prosperous and affluent farmers.

3. Precisely Align the Goals and Tasks of Providing Judicial Services for Comprehensively Promoting Rural Revitalization and Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization. During the "14th Five-Year Plan" period, China will enter a new development stage. People's courts at all levels must establish and improve a work system that connects the upper and lower levels and implements measures throughout, focus on goals and tasks, assign responsibilities, supervise and inspect, incorporate services for consolidating and expanding poverty alleviation achievements into the overall work of adjudication and execution, and promote the implementation of various policies and measures of the people's courts to serve and safeguard the comprehensive promotion of rural revitalization and the acceleration of agricultural and rural modernization.

II. Stabilize the Foundation of Agricultural Development, Promote High-Quality and Efficient Agriculture

4. Lawfully Punish Illegal and Criminal Acts Involving Important Agricultural Products, Promote the Implementation of the Strategy for Ensuring the Supply of Important Agricultural Products. Adhere to the policy of strict punishment according to law, severely and promptly punish criminal acts such as smuggling of rice, corn, sugar and other agricultural products, maintain a high-pressure stance against smuggling of important agricultural products, and ensure the food hygiene safety and quality safety of agricultural products for the people. Strictly crack down on illegal acts such as overdosing or exceeding the scope of medication, unauthorized use of raw drug materials, and failure to comply with withdrawal periods and withholding periods; strengthen the effective connection between administrative law enforcement and criminal justice; promote the control of pesticide and veterinary drug residues; and ensure the "safety on the tip of the tongue" of the people. Continue to promote the punishment of criminal acts involving the production and sale of fake seeds, fake fertilizers, fake pesticides and other counterfeit agricultural materials; ensure the security of supply of grain and important agricultural products; protect the order of agricultural production and operation; and boost the quality of agriculture.

5. Implement the Strictest Farmland Protection System, Ensure National Food Security. Strictly crack down on criminal acts that damage land resources; lawfully determine that contracts for illegal occupation of farmland for building houses are invalid; support administrative organs in lawfully carrying out land administrative law enforcement. Actively cooperate with relevant departments to promote special rectification actions against illegal occupation of farmland for building houses; increase the enforcement of monetary payment obligations in effective judgments and administrative penalty decisions involving illegal acts of occupying farmland for building houses; resolutely curb the "non-agriculturalization" of farmland and prevent "non-grain production." Comprehensively utilize the adjudication functions of criminal, civil, and administrative trials; promote the control of farmland pollution; and adhere to the red line of 1.8 billion mu of farmland.

6. Lawfully Adjudicate Cases on Rural Land Contracting and Management, Promote the Development of Modern Agriculture. In accordance with the requirements of "implementing collective ownership, stabilizing farmers' contracting rights, and revitalizing land management rights," lawfully adjudicate disputes arising from the "three rights division" of rural land; promote the improvement of the two-tier management system based on household contract management and the combination of unified and separate management; ensure the stability and long-term unchanged rural land contract relations; and protect the legitimate rights and interests of farmer collectives, contracting households, and operating entities. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving the mortgage of land management rights and contracts for the transfer of land management rights; ensure the orderly transfer of rural land management rights; promote the cultivation of family farms and the quality improvement of farmer cooperatives; and assist in the construction of a modern agricultural management system.

7. Strengthen Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights Related to Agriculture, Promote Progress and Innovation in Agricultural Science and Technology. Strengthen the adjudication of intellectual property cases related to agriculture; increase the judicial protection of intellectual property rights for key core agricultural technologies such as "bottleneck" germplasm resources; stimulate innovation vitality; and promote self-reliance and self-improvement in agricultural science and technology. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving infringement of new plant variety rights; adhere to the judicial concept of favoring rights protection; expand the scope of legal protection for breeding innovation achievements; and promote breeding innovation through judicial means. Strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights in the seed industry; strengthen communication and cooperation with relevant departments; promote the effective connection between judicial protection and administrative protection; and promote high-quality and efficient cooperation. Strengthen the judicial protection of intellectual property rights in the seed industry of the "Nanfan Silicon Valley"; promote the construction of seed production bases and improved variety breeding systems; boost variety improvement, quality enhancement, brand building, and standardized production; and enhance the internal driving force of independent innovation in the seed industry.

8. Strengthen Judicial Protection of the Agricultural Ecological Environment, Promote Green Agricultural Development. Adhere to the concept of ecological priority and green development; give full play to the guiding and forcing role of ecological and environmental protection; promote the comprehensive control of desertification, stony desertification, soil erosion on sloping farmland, agricultural non-point source pollution, and the protection and over-extraction control of groundwater in key areas; increase judicial protection of black soil; and promote the comprehensive green transformation of rural economic and social development by continuously improving environmental quality. Increase the punishment of illegal and criminal acts involving agricultural environmental pollution and ecological damage; ensure the effective implementation of the "strictest rule of law" for protecting the ecological environment; and safeguard agricultural ecological security. Lawfully adjudicate disputes over liability for environmental pollution and ecological damage in rural areas, as well as civil and administrative public interest litigation cases; adhere to the concept that "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets"; strengthen environmental governance and ecological restoration; and explore diverse ways of assuming responsibility. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving fishing bans in key waters such as the Yangtze River and the Yellow River; give full play to the effectiveness of basin-wide judicial collaboration; and continuously promote the overall protection and systematic governance of the ecological environment of large rivers.

III. Assist Rural Construction Actions, Create Livable and Business-Friendly Beautiful Villages

9. Implement the Holistic Approach to National Security, Promote Rural Harmony and Stability. Continuously promote the normalization of the fight against organized crime and vice in rural areas; severely punish clan evil forces and rural criminal forces such as "village bullies," "market bullies," "trade bullies," and "road bullies"; and continuously enhance the people's sense of security. Lawfully punish criminal acts that infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of left-behind children, women, the elderly, persons with disabilities, and children in difficult circumstances in rural areas; increase judicial protection for special vulnerable groups such as left-behind children, women, the elderly, persons with disabilities, and children in difficult circumstances; and strengthen care services for left-behind children, women, the elderly, persons with disabilities, and children in difficult circumstances in rural areas. Increase punishment of illegal religious activities and infiltrative activities by foreign forces in rural areas; severely crack down on the crime of organizing and using cult organizations; and prevent cult infiltration into rural areas. Cooperate with relevant departments to establish and improve rural emergency management mechanisms; lawfully prevent the use of religion or cults to interfere in rural public affairs; and promote the consolidation of the rural grassroots political power.

10. Serve the Fight Against Pollution, Promote the Improvement of the Rural Living Environment. Focusing on the overall goal of fighting the battle against pollution, lawfully perform duties and responsibilities; support rural areas in promoting special action for domestic waste treatment; and promote the improvement of the rural living environment. For prominent issues strongly reflected by the masses such as sewage, black and odorous water bodies, and garbage pollution in rural areas, lawfully and efficiently adjudicate relevant cases; use judicial means to promote the improvement of ecological and environmental quality; and assist in promoting village cleaning and greening actions.

11. Properly Adjudicate Disputes Involving Rural Infrastructure Construction, Assist in Making Up for Weaknesses and Shortcomings in Rural Development. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving major infrastructure construction projects such as expressways, passenger-freight railways, water conservancy, electric power, airports, and communication networks in rural areas; continuously promote the improvement of infrastructure conditions in rural areas. Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving the construction of rural resource roads, industrial roads, tourism roads, etc.; continuously promote the construction of "good rural roads in construction, management, maintenance, and operation." Lawfully adjudicate disputes involving the construction of storage, preservation, cold chain logistics facilities for agricultural products and food in rural areas; support the development and growth of rural specialty industries.

12. Strengthen Judicial Protection of Historical and Cultural Heritage in Rural Areas, Promote the Inheritance of Excellent History and Culture. Lawfully adjudicate cases involving the destruction of historical and cultural towns and villages, cultural relics, historical buildings, traditional villages, traditional dwellings, and other rural tangible cultural heritage; strengthen judicial protection of rural tangible cultural heritage. Comprehensively use various means to promote the inheritance, development, and utilization of rural intangible cultural heritage.

13. Assist in the Market-Oriented Allocation Reform of Rural Factors, Stimulate the Endogenous Power of Rural Development. Prudently adjudicate disputes involving collective commercial construction land; promote the exploration and implementation of the system for the market entry of rural collective commercial construction land; assist in the market-oriented allocation of land factors; and promote the reform of the rural land system. In accordance with national policies and relevant guidance opinions, distinguish between pilot areas for the reform of the homestead system designated by the state and non-pilot areas; lawfully and properly handle disputes arising from the mortgage, guarantee, and transfer of homestead use rights; lawfully protect the rights and interests of the parties; and assist in the reform of the rural homestead system. Further promote the connection between mediation and arbitration of labor and personnel disputes and litigation; properly adjudicate labor dispute cases involving migrant workers; support the market-oriented allocation of factors such as labor; guide the reasonable, smooth, and orderly flow of labor factors; and promote the improvement of factor transaction rules.

14. Give Play to the Normative Guidance and Value Orientation Role of Judicial Judgments, Promote Rural Civilization. Take the opportunity of implementing the Civil Code; strengthen the reasoning of judgment documents; deeply promote the integration of core socialist values into the reasoning of judgment documents; and promote the transformation of core socialist values into the emotional identification and behavioral habits of the masses. Implement the "Outline for the Implementation of Civic Moral Construction in the New Era"; adhere to the integration of core socialist values into judicial work; use methods that the masses like to see, strengthen case-based legal explanation and legal publicity; use the rule of law to vigorously promote truth, goodness, and beauty, crack down on falsehood, evil, and ugliness; and achieve the rule of law to bring peace to the world and morality to win the hearts of the people.

IV. Implement Policies to Benefit and Enrich Farmers, Ensure Farmers are Prosperous and Well-off

15. Lawfully Punish Criminal Acts Involving Agricultural Investment and Agricultural Subsidies, Ensure the Effective Implementation of Policies to Benefit and Enrich Farmers. Strictly crack down on criminal acts of embezzling, misappropriating, and corrupting agricultural investment funds; promote the management and standardized use of agricultural funds; and ensure the effective utilization of agricultural investments. Lawfully punish criminal acts of intercepting and squeezing agricultural subsidies; ensure that agricultural support policies are implemented; and effectively ensure that agricultural subsidies truly benefit farmers. Lawfully punish illegal and criminal acts in areas such as collective asset management and land expropriation; promote the rectification of micro-corruption at the rural grassroots level; and continuously enhance the sense of happiness of farmers.

16. Actively Carry Out Special Actions to Root Out Wage Arrears, Lawfully Protect the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Migrant Workers. Strengthen the adjudication and enforcement of cases involving wage arrears in public infrastructure construction in poverty-alleviated areas, especially in the field of work-for-relief infrastructure construction in poverty-alleviated areas; effectively improve the quality and efficiency of the work to eradicate wage arrears for migrant workers. Strengthen the protection of the rights and interests of migrant workers in labor-intensive processing and manufacturing industries; maintain a high-pressure stance against wage arrears; further strengthen the coordination between labor security supervision and law enforcement and criminal justice; lawfully and fairly adjudicate criminal cases of refusing to pay labor remuneration; and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of migrant workers.

17. Lawfully Protect the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Farmers Who Have Settled in Cities, Continuously Enhance the Sense of Gain and Happiness of the Farmer Group. Lawfully protect the land contract management rights, homestead use rights, and collective income distribution rights of farming households that have settled in cities. For farming households that have settled in cities, the people's courts may, through judicial means, support and protect their transfer of land contract management rights within the collective economic organization in accordance with the principle of voluntariness and compensation, or the return of contracted land to the collective economic organization.

18. Strengthen the Adjudication and Enforcement of Livelihood Cases, Effectively Protect the Basic Livelihood of Farmers. Strengthen the adjudication and enforcement of cases involving claims for labor remuneration, alimony, support, child support, pensions, medical expenses, compensation for personal injury in traffic accidents, work-related injury insurance benefits, etc.; effectively protect the basic survival and living rights of farmers. For enforcement cases where the person subject to enforcement genuinely has no ability to perform and the applicant for enforcement faces survival and living difficulties, make full use of judicial assistance funds to promptly provide judicial assistance to applicants who meet the assistance conditions.

V. Adhere to the Orientation of Strengthening the Foundation, Actively Serve the Comprehensive Promotion of Rural Revitalization and Grassroots Governance

19. Increase the Supply of Judicial Resources in Rural Areas, Continuously Strengthen the Construction of People's Courts. Earnestly implement the spirit of the Fourth National Work Conference on People's Courts; grasp and implement firmly the strengthening of People's Court construction and the service for comprehensively promoting rural revitalization and grassroots governance as a long-term task; promote the new development of People's Court work; and promote the construction of a new pattern of grassroots governance. Adhere to the orientation of strengthening the foundation; reform and optimize the layout of People's Courts; establish special circuit courts according to local conditions based on the characteristics of conflicts and disputes; and provide more precise and refined judicial services for resolving "three rural" disputes. Improve the circuit adjudication system of People's Courts; reasonably set up circuit case-handling points and litigation service points; do a good job in circuit adjudication; and minimize the litigation burden on the masses to the greatest extent. Give full play to the functional role of People's Courts; closely follow the governance needs of cities and counties; actively participate in grassroots governance; and achieve the people living and working in peace and contentment, social stability and order, and long-term peace and stability of the country.

20. Strengthen Guidance to Various Mediation Organizations, Effectively Improve the Level of Grassroots Governance. Continuously strengthen coordination and cooperation with other grassroots state organs, grassroots mass autonomous organizations, and industrial mediation organizations such as public security, judicial administration, labor and personnel dispute mediation and arbitration, rural land contract arbitration, and people's mediation committees; in accordance with the principle of "not absent, not overstepping, not misplaced," earnestly fulfill the statutory duty of guiding people's mediation work; and actively do a good job in connecting litigation and non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms such as judicial confirmation. Strengthen guidance to various mediation organizations; further promote institutionalization and standardization; continuously improve the quality and efficiency of mediation; and actively enhance the level of legalization in grassroots governance.

21. Focus on Diversified Resolution of Conflicts and Disputes, Effectively Resolve Conflicts in Their Infancy. Insist on placing non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms first; actively promote the prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes at the source. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao Experience" in the new era; strengthen docking with grassroots Party organizations, political and legal units, and grassroots mass autonomous organizations; promote the formation of joint work forces; and resolve conflicts at the grassroots level to the maximum extent. Actively give play to the dispute resolution function of the one-stop litigation service center; promote the one-stop resolution of disputes such as family disputes, neighbor relations, traffic accidents, medical disputes, consumer rights protection, etc., through mediation and arbitration. Promote the work of People's Courts entering villages, communities, and grids; relying on the people's court mediation platform, through "bringing in" and "going out," construct a hierarchical and progressive path for the prevention and resolution of conflicts and disputes at the source; and promote the discovery, mediation, and resolution of conflicts and disputes on the spot. Explore the establishment of a conflict and dispute grassroots prevention and resolution mechanism with the People's Court as the fulcrum, precisely docking with village committees and other rural social grassroots governance forces; further optimize the functions of the informatization platform of the People's Courts; establish a mechanism for the online circulation of the collection, processing, and feedback of rural grassroots conflict and dispute information; and enhance the practical effectiveness of the informatization platform in resolving disputes.

22. Strengthen Legal Publicity and Education in Rural Areas, Create a Good Legal Environment for Rural Construction. Intensify the efforts to popularize and explain the law through cases; deeply publicize laws and regulations closely related to the farmer masses; and promote the behavioral self-awareness of "doing things according to the law, finding the law when encountering problems." Make full use of time nodes such as the "12.4" National Constitution Day and Constitution Publicity Week, as well as agricultural trade fairs and temple fairs, to organize legal publicity and education activities; and promote farmers to "learn the law, believe in the law, and use the law." Promote the organic integration of legal culture with folk culture and local culture; create legal cultural works with local cultural characteristics that the masses like to see; assist in carrying out mass legal cultural activities; and actively promote the construction of a rule-of-law countryside.

VI. Deepen Reform and Innovation, Continuously Improve the Service Mechanism for the "Three Rural Issues"

23. Adhere to the Principles of Orderly Adjustment and Smooth Transition, Promote the Effective Connection of Policies for Consolidating and Expanding the Achievements of Poverty Alleviation and Rural Revitalization. Focusing on the continuous promotion of the development of poverty-alleviated areas and comprehensive rural revitalization, solidly promote policy service connection; ensure that there is no gap in the work; and enhance the stability of service guarantee policies. According to changes in the situation and tasks, reasonably grasp the pace and intensity; introduce and optimize service guarantee measures; and ensure that there are no blank spots in the policies. Precisely align with the judicial needs of the people in poverty-alleviated areas; gradually achieve the transformation from "two no worries and three guarantees" to service measures for rural industrial prosperity, ecological livability, rural civilization, effective governance, and prosperous life.

24. Pay More Attention to the Concept of Systematicity, Continuously Improve the Quality and Efficiency of Service Work. Implement the concept of systematicity throughout the entire process of serving the comprehensive promotion of rural revitalization and accelerating agricultural and rural modernization; focus on goals and tasks; strengthen forward-looking thinking, overall planning, and holistic advancement; focus on making up for shortcomings and strengthening weaknesses; and continuously promote the quality and efficiency of the service guarantee work of the People's Courts. Focus on serving the goals and tasks of consolidating and expanding the achievements of poverty alleviation and rural revitalization in poverty-alleviated areas; focus on solving prominent contradictions and problems; strengthen the full linkage and connection of service innovation measures; and effectively enhance the comprehensive effectiveness of services.

25. Adhere to a problem-oriented approach and actively improve judicial measures that benefit the people. In accordance with the requirements of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Authorizing the Supreme People's Court to Carry Out Pilot Reforms on the Simplification and Diversion of Civil Procedure in Some Regions and the Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Implementation Measures for Pilot Reforms on the Simplification and Diversion of Civil Procedure, people's courts in pilot areas shall actively optimize the judicial confirmation procedure, small claims procedure, and summary procedure for agricultural disputes, improve the trial organization model, and explore the implementation of an electronic litigation online trial mechanism, so as to effectively reduce the litigation costs of the parties and promote judicial efficiency. Adhere to a demand-oriented approach for the masses, continuously upgrade the one-stop litigation service center, extend litigation services to rural areas and online platforms, and provide parties with convenient, efficient, intelligent, and precise litigation services that allow "handling all matters in one stop, through one network, via one number, and in one go." Strengthen the construction of one-stop litigation service centers, so that parties can handle all litigation matters in one place or on one platform.

26. Comprehensively deepen the construction of smart courts, and empower the people's courts' work in serving agriculture, rural areas, and farmers with science and technology. Fully leverage the major opportunities of building a cyberpower and a digital China during the 14th Five-Year Plan period, actively explore the use of technologies such as big data and blockchain to provide strong technical support for judicial work, strengthen the digital and intelligent construction of measures serving rural public services and grassroots governance, and raise the informatization and intelligence level of judicial work. Build a systematic and complete set of online litigation rules, promote full-process online support, full-process intelligent assistance, and all-round information disclosure in case handling, and enhance the convenience, efficiency, and transparency of judicial resolution of agricultural disputes. Accelerate the modernization of the trial system and trial capacity, and continuously improve the ability and level of people's courts in serving the comprehensive promotion of rural revitalization and accelerating the modernization of agriculture and rural areas.

July 14, 2021
